'''Chad''' (Japanese: '''クリオ''' ''Kurio'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN009|Finding a Legend!]]''. His [[hometown]] is [[Ecruteak City]].

Chad met {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] after {{AP|Pikachu}} hit his Pokémon with {{m|Thunderbolt}}. He later explained why he used his {{p|Fearow}} and {{p|Cyndaquil}} to pose as {{p|Ho-Oh}} and introduced them to his grandfather [[Jaye]]. They later headed up the [[Bell Tower]], where they encountered a {{p|Misdreavus}} and {{p|Stantler}} who were standing guard. After being distracted by Stantler's illusions, the group reached the top of the tower after Goh caught both Stantler and Misdreavus. Everyone called out to Ho-Oh without success, and Chad proceeded to leave with Ash and Goh.
